events.title: Now Available on macOS!
events.summary: We’re happy to announce that Story of The Needle In a Haystack is now playable on macOS! Mac players can now jump into the barn, clear the hay, uncover the story, and enjoy the demo on Steam.And there’s much more on the way! A major update is coming soon, bringing big improvements, new content, and brand-new rooms to explore in the coming days.Thank you so much for all your support. 🌾— Rebel Pickle
